notes: Commencement document of a quarterly liquidity tender by a non-listed closed-end fund ('The Shares are not currently traded on an established trading market'), hence fund_type interval_or_tender_offer_fund and no ticker. Size: up to the LESSER of (i) 9,959,316 Shares, stated as 5% of the WEIGHTED AVERAGE number of Shares outstanding for calendar 2020 (not of the 198,983,536 Shares outstanding at February 11, 2021), and (ii) a number of Shares fundable from distribution-reinvestment-plan proceeds; size_shares and size_pct_outstanding record leg (i) only. Price is 'equal to the NAV per Share as of March 31, 2021' (no percent printed; recorded as 100) — the NAV date is the day after the March 30, 2021 4:00 P.M. ET expiration; shares are processed on or about April 8, 2021. commencement_date is null: the Offer to Purchase and Schedule TO are dated February 22, 2021, but the shareholder letters (seq 4, 5) say 'The Offer period will begin on or before March 1, 2021', so no single commencement date is stated. Conditions: the offer is expressly NOT conditioned on any minimum number of Shares; the per-holder rule (tender at least 25% of Shares purchased or all, $5,000 minimum remaining balance) is a tender requirement, not a minimum_tender condition. 'other' = repurchase would violate securities, commodities or other laws. Market_disruption covers banking moratorium, credit/FX limitations and war/calamity.
